scope: Pure bounded durable queue and validation only. This commit does not expose report intake or staff review to visitors. Integrated browser/Room/Lobby delivery is a separate change.

coverage: Explicit consent and exact permitted fields; multiline quotes/reasons and single-line claimed names.
Purpose-separated opaque reporter/room/target references; no room key or raw beta SID stored.
Required atomic storage write before acknowledgement; serialized copy-on-write; uncertain-write reload.
Idempotent immutable report payload and room binding across connection changes; conflicting nonce rejected.
Durable per-session and global limits; queue capacity; corruption fail-closed.
Resolve/dismiss removes saved quote/name/reason and preserves actual disposition on duplicate.
Expiration and persisted cleanup; no AI call, independently verified quote or automatic sanction.

remaining: Integrate protected relay intake and fresh authenticated staff delivery.
Verify candidate UI and real local Worker persistence.
Required human/Karen review and later hosted acceptance; no deployment or public launch.
